# iosxe_wireless_flex_profile (Resource)

This resource can manage the Wireless Flex Profile configuration. The device's built-in `default-flex-profile` cannot be deleted: destroying it only removes the attributes Terraform configured, which reverts them like the matching `no` commands (a description is cleared).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_wireless_flex_profile" "example" {
  name                    = "S2-BRANCH-FLEX"
  description             = "Branch FlexConnect profile"
  native_vlan_id          = 10
  arp_caching             = false
  fallback_radio_shut     = true
  efficient_image_upgrade = false
  vlan_names = [
    {
      name    = "data"
      vlan_id = 20
    }
  ]
  acl_policies = [
    {
      name = "S2-FLEX-ACL"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the flex profile

### Optional

- `acl_policies` (Attributes List) List of Policy ACLs (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--acl_policies))
- `arp_caching` (Boolean) Whether ARP cache feature is enabled for the flexconnect Access Points connected to the Wireless LAN Controller
- `description` (String) Description for the flex profile
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `efficient_image_upgrade` (Boolean) Efficient AP image upgrade is enabled
- `fallback_radio_shut` (Boolean) Whether Fallback Radio Shut feature is enabled for the flexconnect Access Points connected to the Wireless LAN Controller
- `native_vlan_id` (Number) Native VLAN ID for the particular AP
  - Range: `1`-`4094`
- `vlan_names` (Attributes List) Interface name VLAN ID list (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vlan_names))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--acl_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `acl_policies`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the webpolicy Access Control List(ACL) to be mapped to the REAP group


<a id="nestedatt--vlan_names"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vlan_names`

Required:

- `name` (String) VLAN name for the vlan-acl mapping.

Optional:

- `vlan_id` (Number) VLAN ID to be mapped to the ACL for the Access Point identified by VLAN name.
  - Range: `1`-`4096`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_wireless_flex_profile.example "<name>"
```
